definitions.gloss: unused; brand new; not yet used
definitions.explanation: Describes something that has never been used. Common in product descriptions, listings, and everyday conversation about the condition of items.

examples.japanese: {未使用|みしよう}の{切手|きって}がある。
この{商品|しょうひん}は{未使用|みしよう}です。
{未使用|みしよう}の{状態|じょうたい}で{保管|ほかん}されていたので、とてもきれいだ。
examples.english: It was stored in unused condition, so it's very clean.

notes:
Compound of {未|み} (not yet) + {使用|しよう} (use). Very common in online marketplaces, product listings, and commerce to indicate that an item is brand new and has never been used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未使用|みしよう}{品|ひん}: unused item
- {未使用|みしよう}の{状態|じょうたい}: unused condition
- {新品|しんぴん}{未使用|みしよう}: brand new and unused
- {未使用|みしよう}の{切手|きって}: unused stamps

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新品|しんぴん}: brand new (emphasizes being new, not just unused)
- {中古|ちゅうこ}: secondhand, used (the opposite)
- {未開封|みかいふう}: unopened (still in original packaging)
